title: Words of at most three EVA-basic units are more common at line ends than within lines
statement: Among certain paragraph words, the fraction of words of one to three EVA-basic units at the final position exceeds the fraction at strict interior positions and the corresponding fraction ratio under intact-word shuffles confined to each line.
source: Elmar Vogt, The Line as a Functional Unit in the Voynich Manuscript (2012), Sections 4–6, https://voynichthoughts.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/11/the_voynich_line.pdf . Vogt describes different terminal length trends as a function of words per line. This test fixes a pooled short-word threshold of three EVA-basic units and compares it to strict interiors.

public_advisory_rehearsal.summary: Practice evaluation ratios are 1.15745 in ZL, 1.31530 in Takahashi and 1.11877 in RF. The first two pass the fixed upper-tail whole-line test at p=.0025 and RF gives p=.0425. The 3–5 word diagnostic is at or below one in all three editions. At six or more words the ratios are 1.22159, 1.39140 and 1.17846. Keeping initial and uncertain positions fixed in a separate exact conditional test yields p=.00423, .00000135 and .05934 in the same order. Exchangeable and long-initial-only controls pass 0 of 16 each; adding a fixed terminal short-word preference passes 16 of 16. Greedy wraps of independent lengths in widths 40, 50 and 60 pass 0 of 10 each, with median final-to-interior ratios below 0.94.
public_advisory_rehearsal.scope: The declared selection is pooled and includes single-word and two-word lines, which have a final but no strict interior slot. The full whole-line null moves every word, including the original first word and uncertain tokens. Its treatment of certainty is part of the frozen specification. The separate exact diagnostic holds the initial and uncertain slots fixed and requires one certain final and at least one certain interior. The fixed-width control uses one glyph of space and a specified independent length mixture. Results concern that simplified wrap and this type of short-word abundance. The historical source measured mean raw character length conditional on line size.

reproduction.instructions: Write the frozen fact-draft.json and embedded scripts to one directory. From the pinned repository root run PYTHONPATH=. python3 /path/measure.py /path, then PYTHONPATH=. python3 /path/wrap.py and PYTHONPATH=. python3 /path/conditional.py. Only the last diagnostic requires NumPy; the submitted spec uses the standard DSL.
